features.text: SPORT-READY PERFORMANCE: Pull-on design stays securely in place during movement and activity.
BREATHFIT MOISTURE CONTROL: Keeps the knee cool and dry while maintaining therapeutic compression.
TARGETED LIGAMENT SUPPORT: Provides firm, flexible stabilization for ACL, PCL, MCL, and LCL injuries.
ATHLETIC BUILD QUALITY: Lightweight yet durable materials withstand high-impact use and daily wear.
ACTIVE COMFORT FIT: Smooth, low-profile design ideal for sports, recovery, and all-day support.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
